title: Kudanwa Kwakapfuura Nenguva Dzose
intro: Fungidzira mweya wakamira wega uchirwisana netsika yose, wakatsunga kuvatungamirira kubva mukutsauka neushingi husingazununguki. Kwemazana emakore, shoko rakarambwa, rakasekwa, uye rakarambwa—asi kuedza hakuna kumbomira. Pakupedzisira, kuverengwa kukuru kwakauya, uye vashoma chete ndivo vakaponeswa pamwe chete nemweya uyu wakasimba. Unogona here kuona munhu uyu kubva muKorani?
clues: Ndakatumwa semuyambiri kuvanhu vakarasika munzira dzavo.
Ndakavakoka kuti vatsvage ruregerero uye vatendeuke kubva pazvivi zvavo, asi vakaramba.
Ndichitungamirirwa naMwari, ndakavaka chikepe chikuru vanhu vangu vachinditarisa uye vachindiseka.
Ndakadana kuna Ishe wangu ndisingaregi—pakupedzisira vakapindura, uye mvura yakadurura kubva kudenga iri mafashamo.
Ndakakwira muchikepe pamwe chete neavo vakatenda apo mvura yemafashamo yakakwira pamusoro penyika.
Ndakachema kune mumwe akanga asara, ndichivakumbira kuti vatizire pagomo, asi mutemo wakanga watopfuura.
